source_refs.note: 2. Disaccharides: a main subheading of 27.1 Carbohydrates, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 161-161.

blocks.text: Disaccharides do monosaccharide units se bante hain jo glycosidic linkage se jure hote hain; in ka aam formula C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁ hai. Sab se aam disaccharides sucrose, lactose aur maltose hain. Yeh condensation reaction (jis mein chhota molecule, yahan paani, nikalta hai) se bante hain: aik monosaccharide ka hydroxyl group doosre monosaccharide ke hydrogen se mil kar paani ka aik molecule bana deta hai, aur dono units covalent bond se jur jate hain. Yeh C–O–C bond glycosidic bond kehlata hai. Maslan sucrose, jo aam table sugar (cheeni) hai, glucose aur fructose ka disaccharide hai (Figure 27.2).

blocks.alt: Glucose (chhe atoms wali ring) aur fructose (paanch atoms wali ring) Haworth rings ki shakal mein; glucose ke C1 ke OH ka H aur fructose ke C2 ka HO dabbe (box) mein hain. Teer sucrose ki taraf jata hai jis mein glucose ka C1 aur fructose ka C2 aik oxygen atom se jure hain, 'glycosidic linkage in sucrose', + H2O.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.2: Sucrose molecule ka banna (kitab ki Figure 27.2 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dabbe mein glucose ke C1 ke OH ka H aur fructose ke C2 ka HO hai; yeh mil kar paani (H₂O) ban kar nikalte hain (condensation). Bachi hui oxygen glucose ke C1 ko fructose ke C2 se jorti hai: yahi C–O–C glycosidic linkage hai.
